notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Chicken Troupe by paying {1}{G}.
When Chicken Troupe enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {TK} and putting a name sticker on Well Rested.
Activate Yenna targeting the Well Rested with a name sticker by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of it named Well Rested attached to any creature, untapping Yenna, and scrying 2.
Each copy of Well Rested attached to Yenna triggers, each one putting two +1/+1 counters on Yenna and causing you to gain 2 life and draw a card.
Activate Yenna using Cryptic Trilobite's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
